curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Handpicked for political reasons to endure an unforgiving training gauntlet, how far can O'Neil push past the command's unfair demands?
curatedMovie.description: Selected as a test candidate to integrate women into combat roles, Lieutenant Jordan O'Neil enters brutal Navy SEAL training, where a demanding master chief pushes her endurance to the breaking point.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, demanding, and physically punishing, balancing gritty military exercises with deliberate dramatic tension.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ridley Scott delivers an intense military drama driven by grueling physical stakes, institutional friction, and a fierce battle for earned respect.
